blocks.title: Solids
blocks.text: Solids woh cheezen hain jo rigid aur hard (sakht) hoti hain aur jin ki shakal aur volume dono fixed hote hain.

Solid banane wale atoms, ions aur molecules bohat qareeb qareeb closely packed (qareeb bhare) hote hain. Unhen mazboot cohesive (jorne wali) forces pakre rakhti hain. Is liye solid ke atoms, ions ya molecules random (be-tarteeb) motion nahi kar sakte.

blocks.prompt: Solid ke particles ki harkat ka liquid aur gas se comparison karein.
blocks.explanation: Solid mein particles mazboot cohesive forces se apni jagah jame rehte hain aur sirf wahin vibrate karte (larazte) hain. Liquid mein particles qareeb rehte hain magar ek doosre ke paas se guzar sakte hain, is liye liquid behta hai. Gas mein particles zyada tar khali jagah mein azadi se urte hain.

items: Solids sakht hain, shakal aur volume fixed; particles qareeb qareeb, mazboot cohesive forces se jure, random motion nahi kar sakte.
